jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

As a Sr. Project Manager, you will be responsible for providing consulting services to an assigned market or client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives. This person can work remote but travel will be up to 30%.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion.

What You’ll Do:

Oversee the management and construction of projects within region to ensure timelines, specifications, quality and costs are achieved within approved parameters.
Ensure direct, indirect, outsourced service providers and vendors provide consistent, high-quality services.
Ensure team compliance with corporate and local standards and procedures related to design approval (construction, safety, fire and premises occupation requirements, including permits).
Collaborate with Client AD&E and Program Leads to facilitate programmatic deliverables and budgets (charters) for review and approval.
Collaborate with CBRE and Client leadership to ensure implementation strategy and overall branch construction completion.
Demonstrate fluency with Client Design Guidelines as applied to project implementation.
Act as first point of escalation for all project related issues and opportunities requiring timely resolution.
Work with governance and control organization to ensure governing standards are met.
Work collaboratively with the regional client Construction Leads to ensure client responsibility vs landlord responsibility.
Identify and escalate all gaps in scope of work for escalation and resolution.
Manage the performance of external consultants and vendors in a collaborative and cooperative manner.
Ensure Project Managers establish direct communications with all CBRE and Client Vendors to maintain timely and accurate project implementation.
Lead all necessary vendor training as needed based on the programmatic variations ensuring vendors have updated guidelines/client direction
Focus and document continuous improvement of program innovation, cost, process and time savings.
Develop specific client requirements and establish clear and verifiable expectations.
Ensure a consistent standard and approach to delivery and design across the regions.
Seek and implement time saving and process refining tasks to ensure comprehension and compliance.
Ensure project team adherence to the client issued Playbook, Design Guidelines and all other written policies
Ensure project team compliance with all CBRE and Client Health and Safety policies
Ensure all required documentation is memorialized timely by the project team via PM Web, MS Teams or other tools.
Provide assistance and guidance for scoping and evaluation of prospective work as part of due diligence exercises.
Schedule and lead project meetings as required, including preparation of agendas and meeting minutes.
Create and distribute project status/project progress reports to team and management as required

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-10 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Experience:

Ability to exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.
Willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects:

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time.

Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner & Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.

jobs.title: Enterprise Project Manager (M&A Integration Focus)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Want to take your project management expertise to new levels? Come join our team of highly skilled portfolio and project managers in the Enterprise Project Management Office team. This role will be focused on support of the Integration Management Office within the EPMO and report to the Vice President of Enterprise PMO.

The Enterprise PMO is responsible for leading projects for the Transformation Office including important M&A Integration Projects. In addition to Integration projects, will also be assigned as cross-functional project leader for other high impact, Enterprise-wide projects as bandwidth and experience align.

As Project Manager, you will lead high impact Enterprise projects by leveraging deep project management expertise; manage project timeline, deliverables and execution leading cross functional teams of subject matter experts; and be accountable for stakeholder communication and risk management. Your background and experience in a specific area will support your assignments to specific projects. Primary assignments for Enterprise Project Managers will be projects that involve multiple Agilent functions and need neutral facilitation to balance multiple sponsors and stakeholders.

Specific responsibilities include
:

Lead key strategic cross-functional projects by leveraging deep project management expertise
Special emphasis on leading large cross-functional teams through an M&A Integration including close interactions with VP GMs and Executive Leadership and functional team members. Other Enterprise projects will complete your portfolio of projects when bandwidth allows.
Manage project timeline, deliverables, and execution, operating with subject matter experts in various functions as needed
Translate project needs into specific deliverables that evolve the commercial model
Ensure projects meet performance targets by adhering to processes, and follow standard tracking and reporting for projects
Monitor and escalate identified issues and performance deviations
Design stakeholder management and communication plan to customize to the needs of the project and the stakeholders. And engage with change management specialist to design and deploy change management activities
Organize and run project meetings, clearly documenting project progress using standard templates and processes
Ensure monitoring against project objectives throughout the execution
Ensure operational handover of project deliverables (processes, tools…) at project closure
Participate in continuously evolving and developing the project management center of excellence capabilities
Actively engaged in success of the project—formulates and actions solutions to address challenges.
Able to translate complex project information to critical risks and issues for senior leaders.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelors or Masters University Degree or equivalent.
10+ years of experience in project management at all levels of the organization
Solid track record of working across multiple functions in a matrixed organization. Demonstrated skill in partner management and meeting facilitation.
Agilent business acumen and familiarity with how to navigate in complex global environment
Effective interpersonal skills in teamwork, negotiation, and networking
Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and uncertainty while maintaining attention to detail.
Excellent listening and written & verbal communication skills

Preferred

Experience in M&A Processes and Stage Gate as functional lead or project leader.
Project Management certification (e.g. PMP)

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least August 24, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $143,760.00 - $269,550.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp Oncology is seeking a Sr. Project Manager
to join our team.

Work Schedule:
Monday - Friday, 1st Shift

Job Summary

The Sr. Project Manager is a strategic leader responsible for driving the successful delivery of large, complex, and cross-functional projects across diverse technologies and business domains. This role requires exceptional leadership and the ability to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum in dynamic environments. Sr. Project Managers are accountable for delivering outcomes on time, within scope, and on budget, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously. They excel at identifying and mitigating risks, communicating project health and success probability across all organizational levels, and seeing the big picture to ensure alignment with broader business goals. With deep expertise in project management fundamentals, they serve as mentors and change agents, continuously improving delivery practices and enabling organizational growth.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, strategic projects with high complexity, cross-functional impact, and visibility across the organization.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including task dependencies, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocations, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Collaborate closely with Program Managers to ensure project alignment within broader program goals, portfolio priorities, and strategic initiatives.
Proactively identify, assess, and prioritize risks; develop and implement robust mitigation strategies to minimize impact and ensure project continuity.
Navigate ambiguity and evolving requirements by applying sound judgment, adaptability, and strategic foresight to keep projects on track.
Partner with department leads, product managers, and functional stakeholders to resolve major challenges and ensure successful project outcomes.
Provide clear, concise, and actionable project updates to senior leadership, influencing strategic decisions and organizational direction.
Monitor and manage project performance against scope, schedule, and budget; escalate issues appropriately and drive resolution through effective governance.
Oversee project financials, including budget planning, expense tracking, and variance analysis to ensure fiscal accountability.
Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible; address gaps in ownership or accountability to maintain momentum.
Foster cross-functional collaboration to overcome obstacles and drive projects toward successful delivery.
Mentor and guide other project managers, sharing best practices, tools, and techniques to elevate project management maturity across the organization.
Contribute to continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and methodologies at both the project and portfolio level.
Champion a culture of transparency, accountability, and results-driven execution across project teams.

Minimum Qualifications

5 or more years of project management experience
3 or more years of experience within biotech, molecular diagnostics, medical device, or a similarly regulated life sciences industry
3 or more years of experience leading complex, cross-functional product and software development projects,
3 or more years of experience managing projects across multiple stages of the product development lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in project management, scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline
PMP certification
2 or more years of experience supporting or leading FDA-regulated product development

Additional Job Standards

Familiarity with 510(k), PMA, or comparable regulatory pathways
Ability to partner with program, portfolio, and functional leadership to support project prioritization, resource planning, risk management, and decision-making.

Application Window:
8/19/26 - 8/22/26

Pay Range:
$125k - $135K

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Benefits:
Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. For more detailed information, please click here. 

Labcorp Is Proud To Be An Equal Opportunity Employer

Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a customer-facing Project Manager in our Professional Services organization, you will be responsible for guiding our customers through the discovery and implementation processes that ensure best utilization of the Bridgeway software suite to improve transactional processing, calculations, and workflows foundational to the success of the customer's business, while guiding our customers through the process of embracing change when moving from one system to another. Our flexible software covers every aspect of fund administration including eligibility, contributions, claims, pension, annuity, and beyond. Your daily responsibilities include aligning projects with business objectives, constructing detailed work plans, managing teams, achieving milestones, monitoring, and adhering to budgets and timeline, and communicating the results to stakeholders.

This is a remote position, with travel up to 15% of the time within the U.S. and Canada. East coast candidates preferred.

Responsibilities:

Lead client implementations of proprietary software from project kick-off through go-live and transition to support.
Manage communications, escalations, and expectations with internal and external stakeholders.
Develop project plans, regularly monitor and update schedules, budget and project estimates in the online professional services automation solution.
Assume accountability for on time and in budget delivery of projects, in addition to regular, accurate forecasting of project financials.
Monitor, evaluate and predict resources needed to reach objectives and manage resources in an effective and efficient manner.
Manage scope against contract deliverables, maintain margin objectives and meet billable utilization objectives.
Identify potential risks affecting budget, timeline and efficiency and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
Create and maintain a comprehensive project documentation.
Participate in process improvement activities to increase efficiency and speed to market for customer projects.
Perform risk management analysis to reduce project risks.
Collaborate across the enterprise to handle your customer's needs including professional services, sales, support, engineering, technical services/hosting.
Lead and facilitate the requirement gathering, estimating and creation of proposals.
Work with project team to proactively define requirements and coordinate handoff and integration with engineering team work to keep project deliverables on track.
Ensure successful integration of project objectives into client business operations by coordinating training initiatives and ensuring adequate knowledge transfer to Client Services team.
Track performance of the project portfolio against key metrics including identifying areas for improvement and making recommendations for project efficiencies.

Qualifications:

3+ years' experience planning and managing the implementation of enterprise level software or IT consulting projects to external stakeholders, to include ownership of budget and schedule
Ability to work on challenging projects that require creativity and prioritizing work loads
Proven ability to solve problems creatively
Excellent analytical skills
Strong interpersonal skills and extremely resourceful
Knowledge of Agile Scrum projects, methods, and principles
Experience with managing projects using an online professional services automation solution such as AdaptiveWork/PlanView, SmartSheet
Strong MS Office skills
Bachelor's degree in a related discipline
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP), preferred

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Rare Disease)
jobs.description:
Premier Research is looking for a Senior Project Manager (Rare Disease) to join our Specialty team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.
Your ideas influence the way we work, and your voice matters here.
As an essential part of our team, you help us deliver the medical innovation that patients are desperate for.

Join us and build your future here.

What You'll Be Doing

Ensures successful management and coordination of efforts assigned to all members of the global project team, including but not limited to Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Biometrics, and Medical Affairs/Safety, to support milestone achievement and overall project delivery
Ensures adherence to project budget and scope of work to realize project profitability
Ensures all project tasks are completed in accordance with project plans and in compliance with standard Premier Research processes, policies and procedures
Acts as the primary liaison between Premier Research and the customer for all assigned projects and chairs project team meetings and teleconferences
Assists in Business Development activities, including proposal development and leading proposal presentations in partnership with Business Development and Scientific Account Leadership
Develops strong relationships with current clients to generate new and/or add-on business for the future

What We Are Searching For

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a clinical, biological- or science-related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of Project Management experience in a CRO/Pharmaceutical/Biotech/Specialty Pharma industry
Budget/finance/costing experience on a project level
Experience in managing complex trials, multiple phases, and full lifecycle
Global experience required
In depth, multiple therapeutic area and protocol knowledge in Rare Disease indications

Premier Research is dedicated to providing compensation that is fair and competitive with market standards. The annualized minimum base pay for this role is $122,000.00 USD. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Staff Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About The Role

Dragos is seeking a Staff Business Operations Project Manager to join our Business Operations & Technology (BOT) team. This role owns day-to-day execution of senior-level operational projects that keep Dragos running — spanning hardware and logistics, lab and infrastructure readiness, procurement and vendor management, and cross-departmental initiatives across IT, Security, Facilities, and Product & Engineering.

The Staff Business Operations Project Manager will work with limited direction, delivering high-complexity projects with meaningful business and financial impact. This individual will maintain comprehensive project plans and forecasts, manage risk across a varied operational portfolio, and give leadership consistent visibility into the status of various initiatives for cross-departmental efforts tied to Dragos’s growth, including possible M&A-related integration work. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution, and thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Responsibilities

Own execution of complex, senior-level operational projects spanning hardware and logistics, infrastructure readiness, procurement, vendor management, internal software migrations, and various strategic initiatives. You must be flexible and willing to work in ambiguity. Must be hands-on and able to drive and own execution, not just provide direction.
Aid in project management of global logistics operations, including international shipments, trade compliance, and lifecycle tracking for hardware deployed in the field, minimizing loss and improving asset recovery.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, roadmaps, and forecasts that reflect milestones and dependencies across the Business Operations portfolio. Must enjoy working in a multi-disciplinary role across Product/Engineer/Operations.
Own sprint tracking and Agile ceremonies for active operational workstreams, ensuring consistent cadence and team accountability.
Lead issue resolution, change control, and risk mitigation independently, escalating only where cross-organizational alignment is required.
Build and maintain financial tracking, budget forecasts, and resource allocation reporting for large-scale operational initiatives.
Provide coaching and mentorship to associate and junior project managers supporting the operations portfolio.
Ensure project governance through consistent reporting, metrics, and adherence to PMO standards and policies.
Reduce single-point-of-failure risk by distributing execution responsibilities, managing risk, and maintaining clear, current status reporting and stakeholder visibility.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience managing IT or business operations projects in a production enterprise environment, with a demonstrated track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives on time and within scope.
Strong proficiency with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and retrospective facilitation.
Experience managing projects using Jira, Confluence, and related Atlassian tools.
Proven ability to develop and maintain project plans, roadmaps, risk registers, and status reports that drive executive-level visibility.
Experience with hardware/asset logistics, PoC or demo equipment lifecycle management, or supply chain operations preferred. International experience is a plus.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business domains without direct authority.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate operational and financial details for non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, including supporting integration work tied to company growth or M&A activity.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate dense regulatory and technical requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences. Focuses on solutions and strategy, not why we “can’t” do it.
PMP, PgMP, CSM, or SAFe certification preferred.
Experience working in a cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology company is a plus; ICS/OT knowledge is nice to have.

Compensation

Salary: $154,000
Competitive Equity Package
Comprehensive Benefits Plan

jobs.title: Architectural Project Manager (Healthcare)
jobs.description:
Healthcare Project Manager – Architecture

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Healthcare Project Manager to lead complex healthcare architecture projects from initial planning through construction and completion. This position is ideal for an architectural professional who enjoys owning the overall success of a project, building strong client relationships, and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.

This is a remote-based position with travel to project sites and client locations as needed. Candidates can work remotely when not traveling, but should be comfortable maintaining a visible presence with clients and project teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Lead healthcare architecture projects from initial client engagement through design, documentation, construction, and project closeout.
Manage overall project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
Serve as a primary point of contact for healthcare clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.
Coordinate architectural, engineering, construction, and other multidisciplinary teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Develop project work plans, schedules, staffing strategies, and resource requirements.
Monitor project financial performance and proactively address potential budget or schedule concerns.
Lead client meetings, design coordination meetings, and project presentations.
Travel to healthcare facilities, client meetings, and active project sites throughout the course of projects.
Support projects involving hospitals, medical centers, outpatient facilities, clinics, senior living communities, and other healthcare environments.
Maintain strong client relationships and identify opportunities for additional or repeat project work.
Mentor and provide guidance to project architects, designers, and junior team members.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture or a related field.
7+ years of experience within architecture, design, or the AEC industry, with demonstrated project management responsibility.
Strong preference for experience managing healthcare architecture projects.
Experience managing projects through multiple phases, including programming, design, documentation, and construction administration.
Strong understanding of project budgets, schedules, contracts, and consultant coordination.
Excellent client-facing communication, organization, and leadership skills.
Ability to successfully manage multidisciplinary teams in a remote environment.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites and client locations as required.
Architectural licensure is preferred but not required depending on overall experience.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Management Solutions (SMSI)
provides expert management consulting, program and project management, and technical consulting services to government and private-sector clients. SMSI has built a strong reputation for client-focused performance, delivering innovative solutions and measurable results that help clients achieve their goals, meet critical commitments, and successfully reach key milestones.

Job Summary

Strategic Management Solutions, LLC is seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) to support our client work with Los Alamos National Lab (LANL). Location: Remote - US

About Switch

At Switch, we don’t just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn’t just about technology—it’s about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world’s most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

The Role: Special Projects Design Project Manager

As a Special Projects Design Project Manager, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of design activities for projects assigned to the Special Projects team. You will manage design from early concept through issued-for-construction documents and support project execution through turnover and closeout.

You will coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure designs meet operational needs, project schedules, budgets, and Switch standards. This role requires strong design management, technical judgment, and the ability to identify risks early while keeping multiple complex projects moving forward.

This position reports to the Special Projects Senior Technical Manager.

What You’ll Do

Lead multiple design projects from concept development through issued-for-construction documents and project execution.
Establish project design scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and budget requirements.
Coordinate multidisciplinary design activities across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, and telecommunications disciplines.
Manage architects, engineering consultants, and design partners to ensure quality, schedule adherence, and contract performance.
Lead design review meetings and coordinate stakeholder comments, decisions, and resolutions.
Review drawings, specifications, calculations, reports, and other design documents for completeness, accuracy, constructability, and alignment with project requirements.
Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, permitting requirements, industry standards, and Switch requirements.
Support data center expansions, retrofits, upgrades, migrations, infrastructure renewal, and capacity growth projects.
Review consultant proposals, scopes of work, schedules, and fee estimates for alignment with project objectives.
Lead constructability reviews and identify opportunities to reduce execution risk and improve long-term reliability.
Evaluate value engineering options while protecting design intent, reliability, maintainability, and project objectives.
Maintain design schedules, track milestones, and communicate risks or delays that may affect delivery.
Support project budgeting and cost estimating during planning and design.
Review design changes, engineering revisions, and related impacts to cost, schedule, and operations.
Support procurement through review of equipment specifications, technical requirements, and vendor submittals.
Identify design, constructability, schedule, cost, and operational risks and develop practical mitigation plans.
Maintain accurate project records, design logs, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and document control.
Partner with Operations to ensure designs support long-term maintainability, efficiency, and reliability.
Develop commissioning requirements, turnover criteria, readiness documentation, and deployment strategies before handoff to build and deployment teams.
Support project closeout, document turnover, as-built reviews, and lessons learned.
Communicate project status, risks, milestones, decisions, and required actions to leadership and project stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

You manage complex design work with clear priorities, ownership, and follow-through.
You communicate technical information clearly to engineers, contractors, Operations, and leadership.
You identify design conflicts and project risks early and bring practical solutions.
You balance quality, constructability, maintainability, schedule, and cost when making recommendations.
You keep multiple projects organized without losing sight of critical details.
You build productive relationships across Engineering, Construction, Operations, Procurement, consultants, and vendors.
You use sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities change.
You maintain high standards for documentation, design quality, and operational readiness.
You take ownership of project outcomes and follow issues through resolution.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent.
5+ years of experience in design management, construction project management, engineering coordination, data center infrastructure, or a related field.
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering and construction design packages.
Working knowledge of data center or mission-critical facility design, construction practices, and infrastructure systems.
Ability to read and review engineering drawings, specifications, technical reports, and construction documents.
Experience managing consultants, contractors, vendors, or other external project partners.
Working knowledge of applicable building codes, permitting processes, and design standards.
Strong project management, scheduling, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams at the same time.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with project management, design coordination, and document control tools.
Ability to travel and support off-hours, weekends, commissioning activities, or extended work periods when project schedules require.
Ability to work in active construction environments and wear required Personal Protective Equipment.
Ability to perform the essential functions of the role, including walking construction sites and occasionally lifting or carrying up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.
Experience supporting data center operations, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, BIM platforms, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Procore, or similar tools.
Knowledge of commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness, and turnover processes.
Experience with lifecycle planning, maintainability, capacity planning, or infrastructure reliability.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

Why Switch?

A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

Join Us & Make a Difference

This is more than a job—it’s a mission. If you’re ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let’s Build the Future Together.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world

Who are you?

As a Senior Project Manager (SPM)
, you will lead the successful delivery of commercial, retail, and office workplace fit-out projects from feasibility through close-out. You will oversee multiple workstreams across design, procurement, construction, technology integration, furniture installation, workplace transitions, commissioning, and handover while providing leadership and mentorship to Project Managers and junior team members.

This role requires strong technical competence, excellent client-facing skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment. Experience delivering corporate office environments, workplace modernization initiatives, tenant improvements, relocations, and occupied-space renovations is highly valued.

The is a hybrid opportunity based in Toronto, Vancouver or Montreal. We also welcome applications from candidates elsewhere in Canada who are open to relocating to one of these locations.

Job Description

As a Senior Project Manager dedicated to this Enterprise Account you will be involved in;

Project Delivery & Technical Oversight

Lead and manage retail, commercial, and corporate office fit-out projects throughout the full project lifecycle, including feasibility, design, procurement, construction, furniture installation, IT coordination, commissioning, move management, and close-out.
Deliver workplace transformation initiatives, tenant improvements, office relocations, consolidations, and occupied-space renovations.
Review, interpret, and coordinate construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation to identify risks, gaps, and constructability issues.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, landlords, property managers, and authorities having jurisdiction to ensure design and construction compliance.
Collaborate with workplace strategy, facilities management, corporate real estate, IT, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure project outcomes align with organizational objectives.
Coordinate workplace technology requirements, including structured cabling, AV systems, security systems, access control, and smart office solutions.
Manage phased construction activities within occupied office environments while minimizing operational disruption and maintaining business continuity.
Conduct regular site visits as required to monitor progress, quality, safety, and adherence to scope, schedule, and budget.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, resolving issues efficiently and escalating when appropriate.

Procurement, Commercial & Contract Management

Lead procurement strategies, including tendering, evaluation, recommendation, and appointment of consultants, contractors, furniture vendors, technology providers, and other project partners.
Establish, negotiate, and manage quotations, purchase orders, work orders, and contracts, including Master Service Agreements.
Monitor costs, manage change control processes, and ensure accurate financial tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
Process and certify payments to consultants, contractors, and direct vendors in coordination with the consultant team.
Ensure commercial decisions support project objectives while maintaining quality, schedule, and budget requirements.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, providing clear, timely, and strategic communication.
Lead and facilitate client meetings, design coordination meetings, contractor meetings, stakeholder workshops, and site meetings.
Build strong relationships with corporate real estate, workplace services, facilities management, IT, HR, operations, landlords, and executive leadership teams.
Manage client expectations while balancing scope, schedule, quality, and budget constraints across multiple concurrent projects.
Support workplace change management initiatives, occupancy planning, move management, transition activities, and post-occupancy stabilization.
Prepare and deliver concise project updates, reports, dashboards, and presentations to senior client representatives and executive stakeholders.

Leadership & Team Development

Provide leadership, mentorship, and guidance to Project Managers and other team members, fostering professional development and project management best practices.
Support workload planning, resource allocation, and review of project deliverables to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with account standards.
Promote a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team culture.
Lead by example in project governance, documentation standards, risk management, and client service excellence.
Support the ongoing development and continuous improvement of project management processes across the account.

Administration, Reporting & Close-Out

Maintain comprehensive project documentation in a highly administrative, multi-project environment.
Ensure accurate scheduling, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and document control using established project management systems.
Coordinate and administer project close-out activities including deficiencies, commissioning, turnover documentation, occupancy readiness, and lessons learned workshops.
Drive continuous improvement through post-project reviews, knowledge sharing, and implementation of best practices.
Ensure all project records are maintained in accordance with client, contractual, and organizational requirements.

Qualifications

7+ years
of progressive experience managing construction projects, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
Experience delivering retail or commercial, and/or corporate fit‑out projects
is required.
Experience managing workplace environments, tenant improvements, office relocations, workplace modernization programs, and occupied-space renovations is highly desirable.
A recognized university degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
.
PMP certification
or equivalent is highly desirable.
Strong technical ability to read, understand, and coordinate construction drawings and specifications, and project documentations.

Demonstrated experience coordinating furniture, AV, security, structured cabling, and IT infrastructure components within office environments.
Experience working with landlords, property managers, and corporate real estate teams within multi-tenant commercial office buildings is considered an asset.
Proven experience leading client-facing projects and managing senior stakeholders.
Proficient in MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint
, and project scheduling tools such as MS Project or P6
.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail; comfortable juggling competing demands in a fast-paced, administrative-heavy environment.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills with confidence using technology and web-based data platforms.
Willingness to travel to project sites
as required.

Additional Information

What's in it for you...

100% covered health and dental benefits for you and your dependents (including paramedical services)
Health spending account, to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program
RRSP option with company matching
Annual learning and development budget
Access to a range of online learning tools, and support for career development and growth
Coverage of one professional membership or license fee per year, if directly related to your role
We believe in work-life balance, so you can recharge and take care of what matters most with vacation, flex and sick days
A flexible, hybrid work approach that allows colleagues to find balance between their professional and personal lives
Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging

The base salary range for this full-time role is $110,000.00 - $140,000.00
per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This posting reflects an existing vacancy that we are actively hiring for.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

We are an Equal opportunity employer who will ensure accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities upon request. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores
e especialistas em 28 países
, construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.

Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: operacionalizamos a inteligência.

A IA não substitui os seres humanos. Ela nos reposiciona em um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, criar e inovar.

Na Keyrus, você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores.

Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentes setores, mercados e geografias.

Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus.

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR

Esta posição combina visão arquitetural, profundidade técnica e atuação consultiva. Buscamos profissionais capazes de transformar desafios complexos em soluções de dados escaláveis, modernas e orientadas a resultados.

QUEM VOCÊ É

Você é um profissional experiente que combina conhecimento técnico com visão estratégica de negócio.

Você entende que dados são a base para decisões mais inteligentes e para a transformação das organizações.

Você consegue navegar com naturalidade entre discussões arquiteturais, implementação técnica e relacionamento com stakeholders.

Você gosta de estruturar ambientes complexos, criar padrões e impulsionar a evolução tecnológica.

Você equilibra pragmatismo e inovação, priorizando soluções que geram impacto real.

Você compartilha conhecimento e contribui para o crescimento técnico das equipes ao seu redor.

Você possui perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

O QUE VOCÊ TRAZ

Estamos em busca de um(a) Project Manager ou Scrum Master Sênior
, com sólida experiência em metodologias ágeis e conhecimento técnico em MDM (Master Data Management)
.

A pessoa profissional será responsável por atuar junto aos times, facilitando a aplicação das práticas ágeis, promovendo melhoria contínua e garantindo uma boa interação entre equipe, stakeholders e demais áreas envolvidas nos projetos.

Além da atuação em Agile/Scrum, é importante possuir conhecimento técnico em MDM
, sendo capaz de compreender, questionar e discutir temas relacionados à tecnologia e às soluções de gestão de dados mestres.

Experiência e Qualificações

Atuar como Scrum Master ou Project Manager, de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
Conduzir e acompanhar cerimônias ágeis, como Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective;
Facilitar a comunicação e o relacionamento entre o time, stakeholders e demais áreas;
Minimizar interferências externas e criar condições para que a equipe tenha foco e produtividade;
Atuar como mentor(a) do framework Scrum, garantindo a aplicação adequada das práticas e princípios ágeis;
Promover uma cultura de colaboração, melhoria contínua e autonomia;
Identificar impedimentos e atuar na sua remoção, apoiando o time na resolução de obstáculos;
Trabalhar junto à equipe na evolução dos processos e práticas de trabalho;
Apoiar a utilização e análise de métricas ágeis, como Velocity, Lead Time e indicadores de produtividade;
Participar de discussões relacionadas a MDM, contribuindo tecnicamente para decisões e direcionamentos do projeto;
Atuar como agente de mudança, apoiando a evolução dos processos e da maturidade ágil da equipe.

Requisitos:

Experiência sólida como Scrum Master, Project Manager ou em posições similares;
Conhecimento de metodologias e práticas Agile;
Experiência com Scrum e cerimônias ágeis;
Conhecimento em ferramentas como Jira e Azure DevOps;
Experiência com gestão e acompanhamento de projetos;
Capacidade de atuação e comunicação com diferentes níveis de stakeholders;
Conhecimento técnico em MDM (Master Data Management), com capacidade de discutir, questionar e avaliar temas relacionados à tecnologia;
Perfil analítico, comunicativo, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua.

Diferenciais

Experiência em projetos de Data / MDM;
Conhecimento de métricas e indicadores ágeis;
Experiência em ambientes de transformação digital e dados;
Certificações Agile/Scrum ou gestão de projetos.

O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO

Excelente capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Facilidade para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas e escaláveis.

Capacidade de influenciar decisões e construir relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Foco na geração de valor e resultados para clientes e negócios.

Colaboração, compartilhamento de conhecimento e melhoria contínua como parte da sua forma de trabalhar.

NOSSOS VALORES

Inteligência Coletiva

A colaboração entre diferentes especialidades, funções e geografias nos permite combinar conhecimento e entregar respostas mais completas para os desafios dos nossos clientes.

Confiabilidade

A capacidade de entregar projetos complexos com rigor, qualidade e consistência é um dos pilares da nossa relação com clientes e parceiros.

Pragmatismo

Priorizamos impacto concreto e valor mensurável acima de discursos tecnológicos abstratos.

Espírito Empreendedor

Curiosidade, energia, autonomia e iniciativa são a base da nossa cultura e impulsionam a inovação contínua.

About Keyrus

Na Keyrus, ajudamos as organizações a evoluir da IA experimental para a IA industrializada, de agentes isolados para sistemas orquestrados e de insights para execução.

Essa é a disciplina que chamamos de Architect of Intelligence: desenhar o sistema operacional da empresa inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada aos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável.

Impulsionados pelo nosso modelo proprietário Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), estruturamos fundações de inteligência, governança centrada no ser humano e direcionamento de performance para criar ambientes inteligentes onde a tecnologia amplia as capacidades humanas.

Com mais de 30 anos de experiência e 2.800 colaboradores distribuídos em 28 países, ajudamos organizações a ir além da transformação, construindo empresas adaptáveis, resilientes e em constante evolução.

A IA não transforma negócios. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.

Vem fazer parte do Time Keyrus!

Para mais informações: www.keyrus.com.br

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Global
jobs.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview

This role can be based in Denver, CO. in alignment with our flexible work policy (3 days in, 2 days flexible).

Vantage is looking for an experienced and detailed orientated Technical Project Manager, Global, to facilitate the successful completion of projects for the IT department. As a key contributor, this position will interface regularly with internal groups such as Construction and handle external suppliers. The ability to influence and cultivate consensus across teams at all organizational levels is crucial to succeed in this role. A good understanding of business processes, challenges, and goals is required to provide insightful ideas and creative solutions when faced with issues. Ultimately, the role will suit someone who is forward-thinking and can navigate obstacles well.

Essential Job Functions

Project Management:

Lead project planning, resource management, reporting, and implementation of IT projects globally, including North America, EMEA, and APAC regions.
Project manage complex data center migrations and other technical projects, ensuring all project deliverables are met.
Coordinate and deliver IT projects on schedule and within budget, handling any challenges that arise with strategic problem-solving.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Collaborate with various departments and external suppliers to ensure successful project execution.
Negotiate and influence multiple teams with opposing priorities, reducing conflict, and fostering better relationships to achieve project success.
Partner with procurement to work with suppliers and vendors, assist with pricing negotiation, and coordinate work as required.
Performance Measurement and Reporting:
Design and develop performance measurements, metrics, and dashboards to provide analytical insights to business partners.
Create clear and accurate reports throughout the project's lifecycle, keeping partners informed of progress, risks, and issues.
Continually assess ongoing projects, identify potential issues, and adapt plans strategically to overcome hurdles.

Team Leadership and Development:

Assign and oversee project tasks across all impacted customers, holding the team accountable to established milestones.
Coach, mentor, and train others on continuous improvement techniques and standard methods for reporting results.
Ensure that all project handover activities, including manuals and training, are completed successfully.

Technical Expertise:

Use Technical Project Management experience to improve all aspects of project planning, resource management, reporting, solution evaluation, and implementation.
Solve technical problems by implementing preventative controls, conducting data analysis, identifying root causes, and developing effective control plans.
Work closely with teams to provide analytical insights, process improvements, operational excellence, and enhance customer success.

Additional Duties:

Handle additional duties as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred or relevant experience.

Experience:

5+ years of project management experience with emphasis on continuous improvement in a technical field with demonstrable results
Extensive experience project managing complex data center migrations with an emphasis on IT Design.

Skills:

Good knowledge of networking within a data center and how it interconnects disparate systems such as Security, BMS, etc.
Strong statistical analysis skills with a high attention to detail and accuracy.
Highly skilled at reporting Key Performance Indicators using automated reporting and live dashboards, which will be used at all organizational levels.
Expert organizational and communication skills with ability to multi-task and quickly contribute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools such as JIRA, MS Project, and ServiceNow.
Accredited professional project management certifications such as Prince2, APM (PMQ/PPQ), and Agile.
Functions of this position are to be performed in a company-designated office or field location in line with the company's flexible working policy, at least three days a week.
Travel required is expected to be up to 5% but may increase over time as the business evolves.

Physical Demands And Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

Salary Range: $135,000 - 145,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Vantage Data Centers does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage Data Centers.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Here is what you will be doing:

Team Management:

Supports the Senior Project Managers, Technical and Associate Directors with implementing the overall strategic goals
Supervises groups of Assistant Project Managers and coordinates their activities
Ensures that project teams under their supervision comply with project execution, project management and BIM management plans throughout the project delivery process
Engages with other project teams, with related expertise, to confirm project approach and review deliverables
Provides input to the development of the budget and schedule, to meet requirements
May be required to participate in recruitment activities
Supports with performance reviews of the staff within the team
Able to monitor and track the budget on their projects

Technical Excellence:

Provides specialised input to studies within their specific area of expertise
Works autonomously within established procedures and practices, with latitude to determine work priorities
Resolves issues or problems concerning conflicting requirements or complex coordination
Independently evaluates, selects and applies standard industry techniques to execute work assignments
Identifies and develops new processes that lead to improved efficiency or work quality
Liaises with authorities to obtain permits and approvals
Supports the team on complex projects by appointing the right resources and implementing budget control
Assists with bids

Project Management:

Acts as Project Manager on small to medium sized uncomplicated projects or a range of smaller projects
Has a good understanding of project delivery requirements and is well versed with AECOM’s project delivery procedures
Is well versed in the use of Earned Value Management (EVM) to assess progress

Client Relationship Management:
Supports business development and selling initiatives to expand work assignments, including managing client relationships and expectations
Participates in the development of bids and proposals
Leads communication with clients to discuss work scope, requests information to support project execution and receives client comments on draft work products
Presents to clients, senior leadership and other project stakeholders to demonstrate progress

Interdisciplinary Coordination:
Responsible to coordinate with the other disciplines

Qualifications

Qualifications

Here is what we are looking for:
Honours degree in built environment field of study with a minimum of four (4) years' relevant post-graduate experience
B-Tech degree in built environment field of study with a minimum of five (5) years’ relevant post-graduate experience
National Higher Diploma in built environment field of study with a minimum of six (6) years’ relevant post-graduate experience
National Diploma in built environment field of study with a minimum of seven (7) years’ relevant post-graduate experience
Tertiary qualification in Project Management related field of study, such as procurement, quantity surveying, engineering, architecture, planning, contracting, etc with a minimum of five (5) years' relevant post-graduate experience

Required:
Registration as Candidate with SACPCMP (PrCPM), OR
Certification as CAPM with PMI

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Customer Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

YOUR ROLE

Manage complex telecommunications projects with full end-to-end accountability for delivery, integration and customer acceptance.
Plan, coordinate and govern production deployments across multiple environments, ensuring alignment between project and operational teams.
Lead daily deployment readiness and coordination forums to align activities, dependencies, risks and deployment schedules.
Act as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders, managing expectations and ensuring delivery priorities are aligned.
Collaborate with customers to identify project objectives, define priorities and support network transformation initiatives.
Lead technical workstreams including Analysis & Design, Integration, Verification and Validation activities.
Ensure successful solution integration, testing, deployment and acceptance according to contractual commitments and project scope.
Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, production incidents and deployment challenges with engineering and operations teams.
Establish and align operational support processes to ensure solution stability and long-term service continuity.
Contribute to pre-sales activities by supporting solution scoping, estimation, delivery planning and risk assessment.
Lead technical discussions and negotiations while driving execution across multiple project streams and stakeholders.
Ensure project governance, quality standards and KPIs are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify risks proactively and implement mitigation plans to support successful project outcomes.
Advise customers on network evolution opportunities and contribute to service expansion and project growth initiatives.
Document project decisions, deployment plans, governance processes and technical delivery frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Minimum of 7 years of experience managing complex, cross-domain technical projects.
Proven experience delivering projects within Telecom Core Networks, Cloud and Data Center environments.
