new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - PDLC
new_jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager
to join our Product & Technology Operations team
and own how we build the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) into a shared execution model across Product, Engineering, and Design.

You will own how work flows from idea to impact across the organization - one language for how work moves, one set of metrics leaders can trust, and one standard for what "good" looks like at every stage of PDLC.

This is a founding role for the function
. You'll define the model, align stakeholders around it, and prove out its value as you build.

What You’ll Be Doing

Define the execution model

Design a PDLC framework that works across Product, Engineering, and Design and across all Lightspeed products.
Define what good looks like at each stage of PDLC, including the artifacts, checkpoints, and exit criteria teams should use.

Build the measurement system

Establish metrics that give leaders a trustworthy, holistic view of how work is flowing and where it's getting stuck.
Design the framework so it measures the system and surfaces bottlenecks, not individual performance.
Build in exception tracking so blocked or off-track work is visible early.

Drive adoption

Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders across every vertical to align on the model and earn genuine buy-in and adoption.
Navigate real differences across verticals and business units without forcing false consistency where it doesn't make sense.
Bring structure to ambiguity - resolve open questions as they surface rather than waiting for a perfect spec.

Build an AI-first PDLC

Define what humans own versus what AI agents own at each stage of PDLC, keeping judgment, accountability, and anything irreversible or customer-facing with humans.
Partner with Engineering to identify where AI agents can accelerate delivery, build pilots, and measure their ROI and impact on speed.
Ensure human checkpoints are genuine decisions, not rubber stamps, as adoption scales.

Evolve the model

Treat the framework as a living system - review it periodically and adjust based on what's actually working.
Report on program health and progress to senior leadership.

What You Need To Bring

Experience designing or significantly evolving a delivery framework, execution model, or program management system - not just operating one someone else built.
Experience leading cross-functional organizations through operational change, including turning skepticism into genuine adoption.
A track record of building measurement systems from ambiguous or inconsistent data, and knowing which problems to solve first versus defer.
Experience partnering with Engineering on applied AI or automation, including how to evaluate and measure whether it's actually accelerating delivery, not just novel.
Strong executive communication skills - able to represent program health, risk, and trade-offs credibly to senior leadership.
Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Design without formal authority over them.
Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and independently structuring a path forward rather than waiting for direction.
As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position

You'd Be Great At This Role If You...

Enjoy building something from a blank page rather than optimizing an existing system.
Can hold a strong point of view on "what good looks like" while staying open to what the data and teams tell you.
Get energized aligning stakeholders with different views, perspectives, and backgrounds.
Think in systems and flow, not individual tickets or teams.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
A culture that celebrates performance
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
Equity options, because this is your company too
Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities.

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (InfoSec), London
new_jobs.description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

Your impact

As InfoSec Technical Program Manager, you will translate Isolabs’ security strategy into engineering reality. Reporting to the CISO, with a strong functional tie to the TPM Discipline Lead, you will operate at the critical intersection of risk management and research velocity. You will steer the InfoSec Roadmap, driving complex security initiatives—from protecting proprietary AI models to embedding Zero Trust architecture—across a fast-moving, highly regulated landscape.

Going beyond traditional project management, you are a technical enabler who partners directly with engineering and ML teams. You will navigate architectural roadblocks, secure sensitive drug discovery pipelines, and ensure leadership has the data-driven, operational visibility needed to protect a pioneer in digital biology.

What You Will Do

Structure and drive multi-quarter security project roadmap, balancing long-term strategic initiatives (e.g., Cloud Security, Platform IAM, Secure SDLC) with immediate business needs.
Lead ad-hoc initiatives and high-priority business requests, such as securing sensitive regulated data transfers for drug discovery to architecting guardrails for novel Agentic AI workflows.
Drive the end-to-end delivery of security projects by working hand-in-hand with engineers, navigating the complex Alphabet/Google Ecosystem, and ensuring high-quality execution.
Educate and advocate for InfoSec across the business, acting as a “product manager” regarding InfoSec’s capabilities, assets, responsibilities, and SLAs.
Build extensive and trusting relationships with engineers, researchers and leaders across the company. Act as the bridge between the business and security in order to provide balanced recommendations to the CISO and the TPM Lead.
Design automated, data-driven dashboards that provide the CISO and engineering leaders with clear visibility into program health, operational KPIs, and risk reduction metrics.

Skills And Qualifications

Essential:

Technical Credibility: Deep fluency across Security, Tech, and AI, allowing you to partner effectively with senior engineers and researchers.
Strategic Execution: Proven track record of driving complex roadmaps from concept to delivery. You excel at navigating ambiguity and taking decisive action when scientific and financial stakes are high.
Pragmatic Risk Management: Ability to make calculated trade-offs between security posture, technical debt, and research velocity without stalling innovation.
Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional ability to influence without formal authority, championing security as a core priority across engineering, ML, and business teams.
Proactive Problem Solving: You anticipate architectural bottlenecks, untangle cross-team dependencies, and turn complex organisational friction into clear, actionable project plans.
Translational Communication: Highly skilled at translating CISO’s objectives into technical requirements and condensing complex technical and organisational challenges into concise and actionable plans for leadership.

Nice to have:

Domain expertise in highly regulated, data-intensive industries (Life Sciences, Pharma, Deep Tech).
Hands-on experience navigating GCP and the internal Alphabet/Google ecosystem (on-corp)
Engineering background with hands-on skill regarding Cloud Architecture, Zero Trust, IAM, and security observability.
Familiarity with InfoSec and AI Management Frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 42001) and emerging AI security frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS).
Industry-standard security or program management certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or Agile/Scrum methodologies).

Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.

Thoughtful

Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave

Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined

Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together

Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

Creating An Extraordinary Company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week
(currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

The successful candidate will provide overall leadership, governance, coordination and delivery oversight of Transmission Line, HVAC Substation and HVDC Terminal Station packages, ensuring safe, timely and compliant execution in accordance with contractual, technical, quality, environmental and commercial requirements.

The role requires extensive experience in Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission systems, multidisciplinary project management, stakeholder coordination and successful delivery of large infrastructure projects from design through energization and handover.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Governance
Serve as the primary interface between the Client, Consultant, EPC Contractors, OEMs and external stakeholders.
Establish project governance, communication protocols, reporting structures and responsibility matrices.
Lead mobilization and management of PMC resources across transmission line corridors, substations and HVDC terminal facilities.
Drive implementation of project execution strategies, monitoring systems and controls to achieve approved project objectives.
Ensure effective coordination across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover activities.

Project Controls & Performance Management
Review contractor baseline schedules, resource deployment plans, procurement schedules and commissioning programs.
Monitor progress against contractual milestones and project KPIs.
Identify delays, constraints and performance gaps and develop recovery and acceleration recommendations.
Review and analyze project dashboards, look-ahead plans and progress forecasts.
Oversee implementation of project controls, risk management and performance reporting systems.

Technical Oversight
Review critical engineering deliverables, design submissions and technical proposals.
Coordinate interfaces involving transmission lines, substations, HVDC systems, civil works, protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and associated infrastructure.
Provide technical guidance on constructability, commissioning readiness, energization planning and operational requirements.
Ensure compliance with applicable technical standards, specifications and regulatory requirements.

Contract & Commercial Management
Review contractor claims, variations, change orders and extension of time submissions.
Support assessment of contractual obligations, commercial exposures and risk mitigation strategies.
Review payment recommendations and milestone achievement certifications.
Ensure project records, correspondence and management decisions are properly documented.

Quality, HSE & Risk Management

Lead periodic quality, safety, construction and risk review meetings.
Maintain project risk registers, action trackers and mitigation plans.
Ensure timely closure of NCRs, punch points and corrective action items.

Stakeholder & Interface Management
Manage coordination with landowners, utilities, statutory authorities, transmission agencies and project stakeholders.
Facilitate timely resolution of ROW, access, crossing, outage, land acquisition and interface constraints.
Support effective communication between multidisciplinary project teams and external agencies.
Provide regular executive-level updates and strategic recommendations to the Client.

Completion & Handover
Lead construction completion reviews, pre-commissioning assessments and energization readiness reviews.
Oversee project handover and close-out activities.
Ensure completion dossiers, test reports, as-built drawings and project documentation are submitted and accepted.
Support transition from construction to operational readiness in accordance with client requirements.

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.

Experience
Minimum 15 years of professional experience in transmission and substation infrastructure projects.
Proven experience delivering EHV transmission line and substation projects.
Demonstrated leadership of at least one major 400 kV or 765 kV transmission or substation project.
Experience in large-scale utility, renewable energy or power transmission programs.
Experience in multidisciplinary project management and stakeholder coordination.

Experience with HVDC converter stations and transmission systems.
Experience in GIS substations, power transformers, shunt reactors and protection systems.
Knowledge of SCADA, telecommunications and grid integration systems.
Experience working as PMC, Owner's Engineer, Engineer's Representative or EPC Project Manager.

new_jobs.title: Construction Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

We have successfully delivered large infrastructure projects across Canada since 2001. Our leadership and expertise span the entire value chain from research and development through construction, operation and maintenance of projects. Currently involved in some of Canada’s largest infrastructure projects, ACCIONA delivers solutions that contribute to the economic and social progress of the communities in which it operates.
www.acciona.ca

ACCIONA is a global leader in sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy, delivering innovative, forward-thinking solutions in over 40 countries. We’re proud to be shaping some of the most complex and transformative infrastructure projects in North America.

In partnership with Metrolinx, ACCIONA is playing a key role in the design and construction of the Eglinton Crosstown West Extension (ECWE), a 9.2-kilometre westward addition to Toronto’s Line 5 light rail transit network. This major infrastructure project includes seven new stations and installation of rail and systems under a progressive design-build model.

Beyond its technical scope, the ECWE project represents a significant investment in sustainable urban mobility, expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 5,800 tonnes annually and eliminate over 6.5 million vehicle trips each year when combined with the full Line 5.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team on a complex, high-value project that supports long-term regional growth and environmental sustainability. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact and advance your career with a global infrastructure leader, we encourage you to apply and grow with us.

The Construction Security Manager is responsible for managing the construction security program for the Eglinton Crosstown West Extension Project. The role supports the Chief Security Officer by implementing the Construction Security Master Plan, coordinating construction site security operations, managing security-related contractors, overseeing physical security systems, maintaining security training compliance, and supporting the identification and mitigation of security risks across the project.

The Security Manager acts as the primary operational security lead for construction security matters and works closely with site construction teams, security guards, systems contractors, emergency services, project management, safety teams, subcontractors, and relevant public-sector stakeholders.

Job Description

Construction Security Program Management

Implement the Construction Security Plan across project offices, construction sites, laydown areas, storage locations, temporary facilities, and other project-controlled areas.
Support the Chief Security Officer in developing, updating, and maintaining construction security policies, procedures, plans, post orders, and related documentation.
Ensure that construction security practices are aligned with project requirements, contract obligations, applicable laws, client expectations, and recognized security practices.
Provide security advice to project leadership, construction managers, site superintendents, and project stakeholders.

Construction Site Security Coordination

Liaise with construction teams, contractors project coordinators and schedulers, safety representatives and jurisdiction officials to ensure smooth, supportive security operations.
Coordinate security coverage for construction sites, laydown areas, project offices, high-risk activities, deliveries, material storage, and special events.
Review and support the development of site-specific security procedures, post orders, patrol routes, access control processes, and incident escalation protocols.
Conduct site visits to assess security performance, identify gaps, review guard deployment, and confirm implementation of security controls.
Support the management of site access control, visitor management, vehicle access, deliveries, gate operations, fencing, hoarding, lighting, CCTV coverage, intrusion detection, and other construction security measures.

Security Risk Assessments

Conduct and update construction security risk assessments for project sites, facilities, activities, and changing construction conditions.
Identify threats, vulnerabilities, operational risks, and security control gaps affecting project personnel, assets, materials, equipment, public interfaces, and construction activities.
Develop practical mitigation recommendations and track implementation of approved security measures.
Reassess risks as site conditions evolve, including during demolition, excavation, major deliveries, utility works, system installations, high-value material storage, and transitions between construction phases.
Maintain a risk register or other tracking mechanism for security risks, mitigations, and outstanding actions.

Physical Security Systems Oversight

Oversee the implementation and operation of physical security systems across the project.
Provide direction to the Construction Security Systems Administrator regarding access control, reporting, records management, system administration, and security system support.
Coordinate with security systems vendors, IT, communications teams, construction teams, and project stakeholders regarding system installation, testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance.
Ensure that access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, gate controls, intercoms, alarms, lighting, and related systems are appropriate for project needs and site risk conditions.
Review system reports, incident records, alarm activity, access data, and other information to identify trends, issues, or required corrective actions.

Security Training and Compliance

Track and manage security training compliance across the project.
Ensure that required personnel complete applicable security training, site access training, awareness briefings, orientation requirements, and any project-specific security modules.
Coordinate with training, safety, HR, subcontractor management, and site teams to confirm training completion before access is granted where applicable.
Maintain or oversee records of security training completion, compliance status, overdue training, and corrective actions.
Support the development and delivery of security awareness materials, toolbox talks, briefings, bulletins, and incident lessons learned.

Emergency Services and Incident Management

Liaise with police, fire, emergency medical services, municipal authorities, transit security stakeholders, and other emergency response partners as required.
Support incident response for theft, vandalism, trespassing, protest activity, workplace violence, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, security breaches, emergency events, or other project-related security incidents.
Provide after-hours availability for urgent incidents, emergency coordination, and escalation support.
Ensure incidents are documented, investigated, escalated, and closed out in accordance with project procedures.
Review incident trends and recommend corrective actions to reduce recurrence.

Contractor and Contract Management

Manage responsibilities related to security guarding, security systems, and other security-related contracts.
Monitor contractor performance against contract requirements, service levels, post orders, project procedures, deliverables, and key performance indicators.
Review guard force deployment, staffing levels, schedules, reports, incident documentation, patrol records, and service quality.
Coordinate with procurement, commercial, and contract management teams on security contractor performance, scope changes, deficiencies, invoices, claims, and corrective actions.
Support the development of scopes of work, technical requirements, service expectations, and evaluation criteria for new or modified security contracts.

Reporting and Stakeholder Communication

Provide regular updates to the Chief Security Officer on security risks, incidents, site conditions, contractor performance, training compliance, and implementation of the Construction Security Master Plan.
Prepare reports, briefing notes, meeting materials, dashboards, and action trackers related to construction security.
Participate in project meetings, construction coordination meetings, risk meetings, emergency planning meetings, and stakeholder coordination forums.
Maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders while protecting confidential and security-sensitive information.

Required Skills And Competencies

3 + years of experience managing security operations in a construction, infrastructure, transit, public-sector, industrial, commercial, or multi-site environment, or alternative equivalent.
College Diploma or University degree in security management, criminology, law enforcement, emergency management, risk management, public safety, or a related field is preferred.
Experience coordinating guard services, access control, CCTV, physical security systems, incident response, and site security procedures.
Experience conducting or supporting security risk assessments.
Experience managing contractors, service providers, performance requirements, or security-related scopes of work.
Strong understanding of construction site operations, project delivery environments, access control, perimeter security, incident management, and emergency coordination.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to prepare reports, procedures, risk assessments, briefings, and action plans.
Ability to work with senior leadership, construction teams, subcontractors, emergency services, and external stakeholders.
Security certification, law enforcement, military, emergency management, infrastructure security, or transit security experience is an asset.

Core Competencies

Security leadership and operational judgment.
Risk assessment and mitigation.
Contractor and vendor management.
Incident response and escalation.
Stakeholder coordination.
Physical security systems oversight.
Training compliance management.
Documentation and reporting.
Ability to operate in a complex construction project environment.
Availability and responsiveness during urgent incidents.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Security GRC
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team at Stripe provides security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities to allow Stripe to make strategic security decisions, measure our risk and control posture, and represent Stripe Security to internal and external entities. The successful operation of our organization accelerates Stripe by optimizing the communication and expectations of our security program.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Security GRC Program Manager with deep expertise in security compliance to serve as the primary interface between Stripe's Security organization and external auditors, regulators, and compliance stakeholders. In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.

In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program. The ideal candidate is adaptable and finds structure in an evolving and maturing organization.

Responsibilities

Act as an information security subject matter expert during cross-functional audit engagements, representing the Security team in walkthrough meetings with auditors and regulators
Serve as the internal liaison (proxy) between and the Security organization to ensure audits are managed effectively and consistently
Create and maintain a central repository of audit evidence artifacts required for compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, and other global regulatory standards
Perform security risk and control assessments against common frameworks to ensure compliance with Stripe's Information Security Policy and Standards and applicable regulations (e.g., ISO 2700x, PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, COBIT)
Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs
Experience conducting security audits and supporting compliance across complex, overlapping regulatory frameworks
Strong program management skills with proficiency in coordinating security assessments and managing multiple stakeholder engagements across time zones
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels and translate technical security concepts for auditors, regulators, and executive audiences

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $161,300 - $241,900. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Who We’re Looking For

Toyota’s Cyber Risk Department is looking for a passionate and highly motivated Senior Third Party Cybersecurity Risk Analyst.

The primary responsibility of this role is to conduct cybersecurity risk assessments for third parties across Toyota’s third-party portfolio. This role evaluates each third-party relationship to assess the associated risk profile and the effectiveness of the risk management capabilities in place, ensuring alignment with Toyota’s risk appetite.This position includes reviewing assurance artifacts such as SOC reports, ISO 27001 certifications, and PCI DSS certifications to evaluate the effectiveness of third-party cybersecurity controls. The role also consolidates and communicates risk findings and metrics to operational management and executive leadership while partnering with internal stakeholders to support informed risk decisions and continuous improvement of third-party cybersecurity risk processes. This role requires strong analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills, along with a deep understanding of risk management practices and cybersecurity processes, risks, and controls, to effectively assess third-party risk and communicate findings to key stakeholders.

What You’ll Be Doing

Conduct Cybersecurity Risk Assessments: Conduct third-party cybersecurity risk assessments to verify alignment with Toyota’s information security and risk management standards.
Inspect Assurance Reports: Review and analyze independent assurance artifacts, including SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, PCI DSS certifications, and related evidence, to validate control design and operating effectiveness.
Evaluate and Communicate Risk: Consolidate, interpret, and communicate cybersecurity risk metrics, trends, and findings to operational stakeholders and executive leadership.
Collaborate with Risk Partners: Partner with internal business, security, and risk teams to support informed third-party risk decisions and remediation efforts.
Support Continuous Improvement: Support continuous improvement of third-party risk processes, methodologies, and reporting practices.

What You Bring

A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
Experience in Information Security, Risk Management, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
Experience in the planning, designing, implementation, and execution of third-party risk management programs.
Excellent presentation skills, including verbal and written communication to differing levels of management throughout the organization.
Excellent “soft” skills including relationship building and the ability to influence others through consensus building.

Certified Information Systems & Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Security Auditor (CISA) certifications.

SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. You will own the recurring operations of the business, such as the monthly finance cycle, payroll, onboarding, vendors, filings, reporting, etc. You will work directly with our COO to facilitate smooth business ops and form the backbone of our company.

We are looking for someone diligent with attention to detail. Someone who keeps lists, who schedules the recurring thing the first time they see it, who notices that a deadline collides with a bank holiday before anyone else does. If you find satisfaction in a well-run cadence and a clean inbox, this role will suit you. It is hands-on, high-trust, and it will give you unusual visibility into how a frontier AI company gets built.

Responsibilities

Finance cycle with our accountants (reconciliations, management accounts, expenses, invoicing) and keep cash, burn, runway, and budget current and trustworthy.
People operations. Own payroll, onboarding, contracts, benefits, and employee documentation, and make sure a new joiner's first two weeks are excellent.
Advisors and compliance. Coordinate our payroll providers, pension, healthcare, banks, insurers, and legal counsel and keep the company in good standing across filings, VAT, statutory obligations, and insurance.
Vendors and spend. Own vendor relationships, contracts, and renewals, including significant compute and infrastructure commitments.
Workplace. Own our London office as a place people want to be, including management of space, equipment, suppliers, and support team events that make every day in the office worth it.
Process. Turn founder-led, manual workflows into documented processes that run without anyone remembering to run them.
Reporting. Prepare inputs for board materials, investor updates, and reporting packs, and work with our German colleagues and suppliers to keep things aligned

Key qualifications

4+ years in operations, business operations, finance operations, or a similar role, including time in a startup or fast-moving technology company.
At least one role held long enough to live with the systems you built and fix them when they broke.
Exceptional diligence. You keep lists, you trust your system more than your memory, and you close things out, including the tedious ones.
Numerate and comfortable in spreadsheets, with the judgment to know when a figure looks wrong.
Genuinely AI-native. You already use these tools daily and reach for them first when work repeats.

Nice to have

Experience as the ops person at a company between 15 and 60 people.
Exposure to venture-backed company operations: fundraising processes, board reporting, cap table administration.
Experience working across multiple entities, currencies, or employment systems, particularly UK and Germany.
Familiarity with Xero, payroll platforms, HRIS (Personio, Bob) and expense tools, Carta, Notion, or Google Workspace.
Real interest in AI, machine learning, computer vision, 3D technology, or deep tech.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Principal Transportation Management Systems (TMS) Program Manager

The Role

You will serve as the global owner and technical program lead
for AMD’s enterprise Transportation Management System (TMS), responsible for defining strategy, selecting technology partners, and delivering scalable, automated transportation capabilities across AMD’s global supply chain.

This role owns the full system lifecycle

You will operate as the single‑threaded owner for TMS, partnering deeply with Logistics, IT, Procurement, Finance, Trade Compliance, and regional operations teams to ensure the platform delivers measurable business value.

A core focus of this role is driving automation and AI‑enabled capabilities
to improve transportation planning, execution, visibility, exception management, and analytics. With high autonomy and broad cross‑functional influence, this position plays a critical role in modernizing AMD’s logistics technology ecosystem.

The Person

You are a technically grounded program leader who thrives at the intersection of logistics operations, enterprise systems, and data. You are comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, making architecture‑level decisions, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. You bring structure to ambiguity, communicate clearly at both working and executive levels, and maintain a strong bias toward scalable, standardized solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Own AMD’s global TMS strategy, architecture, and multi‑year roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise logistics and supply chain objectives.
Lead end‑to‑end TMS vendor selection, including business and technical requirements development, RFP execution, evaluation, and recommendation.
Serve as the principal program manager for global TMS implementation, deployment, and regional rollout across transportation modes and business units.
Partner with IT and external vendors on system design, integrations (ERP, WMS, data platforms), security, and data architecture.
Translate complex logistics and business requirements into functional and technical system specifications.
Drive transportation process standardization and optimization enabled by TMS capabilities while supporting necessary regional variation.
Identify, design, and scale automation and AI‑enabled use cases (e.g., predictive ETAs, exception management, carrier performance insights, cost optimization).
Establish governance models, operating rhythms, KPIs, and dashboards to track system performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
Lead change management, including stakeholder alignment, training strategy, documentation, and user adoption across global teams.
Own post‑deployment lifecycle management, including enhancements, releases, vendor performance management, and continuous improvement.
Ensure TMS processes and data support global trade compliance, audit readiness, and internal control requirements.

Significant experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or enterprise systems roles within a global, high‑tech, or manufacturing environment.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise‑scale system implementations (TMS strongly preferred), including vendor selection and global deployment.
Strong technical program management skills with experience managing complex, cross‑functional initiatives.
Solid understanding of transportation operations, carrier management, freight settlement, and logistics data flows.
Experience working with system integrations, data analytics platforms, and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL‑based datasets).
Exposure to automation, optimization, or AI/ML applications within supply chain or logistics environments.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority.

Company Description

Tech Projects Implementation Manager

London & South

Competitive Salary

At BaxterStorey, we believe great hospitality is powered by brilliant people and the smart, reliable technology that supports them every day.

We're looking for a Tech Projects Implementation Manager
to support the delivery of technology workstreams across BaxterStorey's mobilisation, refurbishment and transformation projects throughout London and the South. Working as part of the Projects Team, you'll help shape technology solutions from the earliest stages of a project, supporting sales bids, undertaking site surveys, defining technology requirements and coordinating implementation through to go-live.

This is a hands-on, fast-paced role that works across Operations, IT, suppliers and client stakeholders to ensure technology is fully scoped, integrated into wider project plans and successfully deployed in live hospitality environments. You'll play a key role in bringing clarity to complex projects, ensuring technology requirements, infrastructure dependencies and operational needs are considered from concept through to handover.

Job Description

What You’ll Do

Lead the delivery and physical implementation of technology workstreams across BaxterStorey's mobilisation, refurbishment and transformation projects.
Act as the technology lead for BaxterStorey sales bids, ensuring technology solutions are operationally practical, commercially viable and fully integrated into mobilisation and implementation plans.
Conduct comprehensive technology audits and site assessments to understand operational requirements, infrastructure readiness, power and data requirements, equipment locations and user needs.
Develop clear technology scopes, technical briefs and implementation plans that support project approval, budgeting and successful delivery.
Coordinate the implementation of EPOS systems, digital ordering platforms, payment solutions, screens, kiosks and other approved hospitality technology solutions.
Act as the link between Projects, Operations, IT, suppliers, contractors and client stakeholders, ensuring technology requirements are understood and integrated into wider project plans.
Manage project plans, timelines, actions and technical activities, ensuring milestones, dependencies and go-live dates are achieved.
Maintain a solutions catalogue in partnership with the Central Technology Team, detailing use cases, infrastructure requirements, lead times, indicative costs and implementation considerations.
Identify and manage implementation risks, site constraints and infrastructure dependencies, escalating issues and driving resolutions before they impact project delivery.
Coordinate supplier activity, site installations, testing, commissioning and snagging activities to ensure technology is delivered to the required standard.
Support mobilisation and refurbishment projects by providing technology expertise during design reviews, build phases, pre-opening activities and operational readiness checks.
Build and lead a network of technology champions and super-users to maximise adoption and ensure solutions deliver operational and commercial value.
Facilitate regular project reviews, providing clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and actions to stakeholders.
Produce clear documentation, including technology scopes, implementation plans, risk registers, handover packs and post-implementation reviews.
Ensure effective handover into Operations, including training coordination, user readiness and support arrangements following go-live.
Capture lessons learned and continuously improve the way technology is scoped, implemented and embedded within BaxterStorey projects.
Support ad‑hoc digital improvement projects that enhance efficiency, consistency and the overall experience for our teams and clients.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

Experience supporting or managing technology projects, ideally within hospitality, retail or a multi‑site operational environment.
Previous operational experience within the hospitality sector.
Practical understanding of EPOS systems, digital ordering tools or other hospitality technology platforms.
Strong organisational skills and confidence coordinating multiple workstreams at the same time.
A collaborative, people‑focused approach, with the ability to build effective working relationships across diverse teams.
Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into operationally relevant language.
A practical understanding of structured project delivery and the realities of live service environments.
Good commercial awareness, with an appreciation of budgets, costs and operational impacts.
A proactive mindset, with a willingness to roll sleeves up and support where needed.
Flexibility to travel to client sites as required.

Additional Information

Why Join BaxterStorey?

At BaxterStorey, food isn’t just fuel - it’s an experience. You’ll be joining a business that genuinely cares about people, creativity and doing things the right way.

This role offers exposure across the business, the chance to work on exciting mobilisations and refresh projects, and the opportunity to play a meaningful part in how our sites are launched and evolved. You’ll be supported, trusted and encouraged to grow, while maintaining a healthy work‑life balance.

If you enjoy working with people, bringing order to complexity, and seeing plans successfully turn into reality, we’d love to hear from you.

(Manufacturing Systems)

Location based onsite
in either Pine Bluff or Little Rock.
Candidates located in Little Rock will be required to travel to Pine Bluff at least once per week. There is a separate travel component.

Why Central Moloney?

Since 1949, Central Moloney has been an industry leader in transformer manufacturing, built on a foundation of quality, innovation, and stability. As an ISO 9001-certified company, we're investing in the systems and technology that power our next phase of growth — and this role sits right at the center of that work. As an Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) implementation takes shape across our manufacturing operations, you'll have the opportunity to lead a project with real, visible impact on how the business runs, while working alongside a team that values accountability, clear communication, and getting things right.

About The Role

Central Moloney is hiring an experienced ERP Project Manager to lead the implementation of Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) at our large-scale manufacturing facility. This is a high-visibility role for a seasoned project manager who knows how to bring structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives — someone who can manage timelines and scope, hold vendors accountable, and keep engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, and IT moving in the same direction. You'll own the project from planning through go-live and stabilization, building the governance, reporting, and risk management processes that keep a major systems implementation on track.

This role is based onsite in either Pine Bluff or Little Rock, AR; candidates based in Little Rock will travel to Pine Bluff at least once per week, with additional travel as needed.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables
Define project scope, objectives, and success criteria in alignment with stakeholders
Monitor project progress and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery

Stakeholder & Team Coordination

Coordinate activities across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, and IT
Facilitate regular project meetings, status updates, and executive reporting
Ensure alignment and communication across all stakeholders

Risk & Issue Management

Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues
Develop mitigation and contingency plans
Escalate critical risks and decisions as needed

Vendor & Partner Management

Manage relationships with third-party implementation partners
Track partner deliverables and hold vendors accountable to timelines and quality standards
Coordinate internal and external resources

Governance & Reporting

Establish project governance structures, including steering committees and escalation paths
Provide regular status reporting to leadership, including progress, risks, and key decisions
Ensure documentation of project activities and decisions

Cutover & Go-Live Coordination

Develop and execute cutover and go-live plans
Coordinate readiness activities across business and IT teams
Support stabilization efforts post go-live

Requirements

Required Qualifications

7-10+ years of project management experience, including ERP implementations
Experience managing projects in manufacturing environments
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)
Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and external vendors
Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) implementations
Experience in engineer-to-order (ETO) manufacturing environments
PMP or equivalent project management certification
Experience managing large-scale, multi-site ERP deployments

Work Environment & Expectations

Regular interaction with cross-functional business teams and leadership
Frequent coordination with external implementation partners
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Travel as required

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Life, 401k, Vacation Pay

Competitive Salary with Annual Incentive Bonus eligibility

Please note & Review the following:
This job is considered safety-sensitive because impairment by drugs or alcohol may constitute a threat to health or safety, and/or a lapse of attention could result in injury, illness, or death.

Central Moloney is a tobacco-free
facility. The use of tobacco products (including cigarettes, cigars, smokeless tobacco, and e-cigarettes/vapes) is not permitted on company property.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital or family status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. new_jobs.description:
The Technical Project Manager
is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of technology initiatives that support client growth, operational excellence, infrastructure transformation, and strategic business objectives across Concentrix. The role serves as the primary interface between business stakeholders and technical workstreams, ensuring projects are properly planned, governed, communicated, and delivered on time, within scope, within budget, and with minimal operational risk, including the successful transition of delivered solutions into Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES

Lead and manage end-to-end delivery of technology projects, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closure
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, and obtain necessary approvals
Coordinate cross-functional IT workstreams (Architecture, Network, Telecom, Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, ITSDM) and external vendors to ensure alignment and resource availability
Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, implementing effective mitigation strategies
Drive governance cadence and ensure required change controls (e.g., CRQs) are completed through the appropriate IT owners
Ensure project deliverables meet quality, security, and business requirements
Manage project communications, providing regular updates to stakeholders and senior management
Oversee project documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with organizational standards
Ensure successful transition of delivered solutions into Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations
Mentor and guide junior project managers and team members

REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration, with at least 3 years of related experience. A master’s degree or PhD is valued but not required.
3-6 years of related project management experience leading technology initiatives, with a proven track record managing complex, cross-functional projects in enterprise environments; Tech, BPO, Telco, or Banking background, regional and global deployments
Experience coordinating infrastructure, network, telecom, cloud, security, migration, or application implementation projects
Experience working with executive stakeholders and global teams
B2-C1 English level

Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in project management software tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira)
PMP, PMO, PMGA, or equivalent project management certification preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; experience with stakeholder management and negotiation

new_jobs.title: Founding Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right.

Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent-dense team where everyone is enabled to do best work of their careers.

The Role

When a carrier or TPA signs with Avallon, they're buying a transformation: AI agents taking over real workflows across claims, operations, and IT, one implementation at a time, against a roadmap that spans years. Someone has to own that program end to end: plan the transformation, execute it, and make sure the value it creates is real, measured, and visible to everyone involved.

Today the founders do this. We're hiring our first Deployment Strategist to own it. You'll run our largest customer engagements, working directly alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers: they build the agents, you own whether the transformation lands. This is the founding hire for the engagement function, so you'll also define how Avallon delivers as we scale from a handful of enterprise accounts to dozens.

What You'll Do

Own the engagement end to end.
Set the plan and drive it from kickoff to go-live: milestones, weekly check-ins, executive updates, commitments that get closed. You define what done looks like and raise risks while there's still time to act.

Build the executive relationships.
Claims leadership, operations, procurement, IT, and the executive who signed the contract. You keep them aligned on what we're building and what changes for their teams. You're a credible advisor to a VP of Claims, not a note-taker in their meeting.

Own the value story.
Agree on success metrics up front, measure them as agents go live, and make the results visible from the adjusters to the executive sponsor.

Be the customer's advocate inside Avallon.
You're closest to what stalls an implementation: the process nobody documented, the system that still needs connecting. You work through those with the FDEs building the agents, and carry their priorities into the roadmap.

Lay the foundation for the deployment function.
Codify what works into playbooks, and set the bar for everyone who joins after you. As the function grows, you'll be the natural person to lead it.

You

3 to 6 years running enterprise programs: a top consulting firm, a large-scale implementation practice, or product management. You can name a program you personally owned, the stakeholders you aligned, and the outcome you were accountable for
Product instinct. You can take a half-formed customer request, work out what's actually behind it, and explain the pain to our engineers in enough detail that they can act on it
A technical spike: you read API docs, follow an integration architecture discussion, and ask engineers questions sharp enough that they check their assumptions
High agency. You create momentum with imperfect inputs, write the plan yourself when there is none, and run several engagements at once without dropping any
You hold your own with a VP of Claims, including the hard conversations when an agent gets something wrong
Based in NYC and excited to work in person

Nice to Have

Exposure to insurance, claims, TPAs, or other compliance-heavy operational environments
Hands-on familiarity with LLMs or experience delivering AI or automation programs
Early-stage startup experience, especially as the first hire in a function

What We Believe In

Eating well: We provide lunch and dinner every workday from local restaurants.
Staying healthy: 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance covered, along with a generous monthly gym stipend.
Getting out of the office together to recharge: quarterly offsites somewhere you actually want to go.

Compensation Range: $160K - $220K

new_jobs.description:
Threat Tec, LLC, a rapidly growing Veteran-Owned Business, is the leader of Operational Environment (OE) replication and Threat Emulation/Wargaming solutions. Threat Tec brings innovative thinking and extensive experience to complex challenges for public and private sector customers. We work alongside our nation's defenders, developing solutions that drive success and protect our future. Join a team that is embodied by an unwavering commitment to professionalism, honesty, and innovation.

We appreciate your interest in joining Threat Tec. While we currently do not have an open position, we are continuously collecting resumes and identifying potential candidates for future opportunities. If you believe your skills and experience align with our company's mission and values, we encourage you to submit your resume for consideration. We look forward to reviewing your qualifications and keeping you in mind for upcoming roles.

The Program Manager & Data Analyst (PMDA) will provide 1st SFC (A) with Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for LREC Advanced Language Training program by applying measurement, test data analysis, materials support, input and query the Special Operations Foreign Language Office (SOFLO) and Language Operations (LANGOPS) database to assess and analyze language training database statistics; thereby enhancing the effectiveness of the unit Language Training Program. The Analyst will collect and synchronize all data and databases from subordinate units for the purpose of conducting consolidated analysis and compiling required reports. The Analyst will develop new and improve current procedures as needed. The Analyst contractor shall be responsible for managing all paperwork and procedures to assist the unit change Control Languages for applicable SOF personnel through Service processes.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

The Analyst shall provide support to the 1st SFC (A) foreign language training program and analyze data. Support shall consist of, but is not limited to, the following general responsibilities:
Assist in the management of their units Advance Language Training to include but not limited to Live Environment Training (LET) and Operational Language Exchange (OLE)
Manage, create, and coordinate the Aircraft and Personnel Automated Clearance System (APACS) for Soldiers attending LETs and OLEs
Familiar and have an understanding of the Electronic Foreign Clearance Guide as it applies to APACS country and theater clearance
Familiar with the CONOP Process for LETs and OLEs IAW 1st SFC(A) Regulation 350-1
Assist the CSU(s) with OCONUS tutor requests in support of Advance Language Training (ALT)
Assist Soldiers with University Program registration impart of the Defense Language and National Security Education Office (DLNSEO)
Compile post Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) ratings following ALT participation
Assess and analyze the SOFLO and LANGOPS databases statistics to enhance the effectiveness of their unit LREC Training Program
Compile data and enter DA Form 330 into the SOFLO Database which is used to track and manage all proficiency levels for their unit
Understand and apply all relevant Service and local policies that effect language testing. Draft changes to policy to better support 1st SFC (A)
Draft and review documentation, provide recommendations, and corrections on all 1st SFC (A) language related administrative material
Compile data as required, prepare reports, and create presentations suitable for senior audiences (military grades O5 to O6). The contractor shall be proficient with data entry and database maintenance, MS Office applications, and local area networks
Compile data as required and prepare reports suitable for senior audiences. This includes unit database and readiness reports
Function as an OPI and Test proctor as needed
Collect and synchronize all data and databases from subordinate commands and seamlessly work with senior-level Program Manager & Data Analyst
Manage paperwork and procedures to assist 1st SFC (A) to change Control Languages (CLANGs) for all assigned Special Forces, Civil Affairs, and Psychological Operations Soldiers through Human Resources Command (HRC)
Function as the Site Lead
Coordinate sustainment enhancement training (SET)
Provide input for LangOps database
Manage Sustainment Enhance Training (SET) Language Cycles
And any other LREC task that the Government Representative deems necessary

Minimum Qualifications

The Analyst shall have graduated high school or possess a GED or 5 years’ experience managing DOD LREC programs
At least 2 years’ experience working personnel issues
Proficient in the use of all current Microsoft Office applications and SharePoint
Experience performing tasks listed above
US Citizenship Required
Secret Clearance Required

Desired Qualifications

Ability to interact on a professional level with administration, faculty, Soldiers, and all personnel.
Effective use of diplomacy, tact, and judgment
Ability to work well independently; demonstrated creativity, self-discipline, and organization; and ability to search and understand new technologies and their potential.

Travel

CONUS travel might be required to conduct LREC testing.

Additional Work Locations

Fort Campbell, Kentucky
Fort Carson, Colorado
Lewis McChord, Washington
Birmingham, Alabama
Camp Williams, Utah

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Federal Acquisition Service
new_jobs.description:
Summary

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will turn raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy by focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.

Location of position:
GSA, Federal Acquisition Service, Office of Business Optimization

We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Learn more about this agency

Duties

The duty location will be determined at the time of selection in one of the following locations: Washington, DC; Kansas City, MO; Fort Worth, TX; Lakewood, CO; Tacoma, WA; Atlanta, GA; New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Philadelphia, PA; Chicago, IL; Norfolk, VA; Tampa, FL; Houston, TX; San Antonio, TX; and/or Orlando, FL.

The Office of Business Optimization, or Optimize, serves as the “dot connector” converting the Federal Acquisition Service vision into an operational reality to drive acquisition excellence. Our office is dedicated to enterprise-wide excellence in operations, proactive customer engagement, and cultivating a top-tier workforce.

Optimize is responsible for strategy development, procedure optimization, supply chain risk management, and data analytics to inform smart business decisions.

You will be responsible for the following duties
:

Turning raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy, focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.
Leading the expansion of Customer Relationship Management System (CRM) and Cloud business intelligence (BI) capabilities through the use of acquisition data within the Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) organization providing documentation and supporting a continuous cycle for obtaining feedback for enhancements and application improvement.
Working with Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) business units and portfolios to define and document requirements; gathering, developing, and writing user stories that support business requirements; supporting and assisting with prioritization of tasks within the Change Control Board (CCB) and help maintain the requirements backlog for sprint releases.
Preparing and conducting briefings for higher level management to explain the impact of business decisions, providing recommendations, viable solutions, or action plans, and proposing guidance and direction for implementation of recommendations.
Creating, updating, and maintaining project documents including: business requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, functional design, data mapping, and report specifications.

Requirements

Conditions of employment

US Citizenship or National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Meet time-in-grade within 30 days of the closing date, if applicable
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959
Direct Deposit of salary check to financial organization required.

If selected, you must meet the following conditions:

Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.

Qualifications

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below.
Your resume must not exceed two pages. To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information:

Name, address, telephone number, email address;
Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade);
Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.
Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.

Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-13
salary range starts at $106,437.00
per year. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience
is experience optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management and contract management. Such experience must include utilizing electronic-business, customer relationship management (CRM), and business intelligence (BI) systems:

Performing audits concerning contract and customer data management for organizational compliance;
Conducting analytical studies to benchmark metrics to identify performance gaps, establish realistic goals, and implement targeted improvements to drive business success;
Reviewing contract and customer data to ensure compliance with contractual terms; and
Compiling data to translate technical reports into presentations for customers and/or senior management.

Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the agency or visit GSA's webpage.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

On a case-by-case basis, the following incentives may be approved:

Recruitment incentive if you are new to the federal government
Relocation incentive if you are a current federal employee
Credit toward vacation leave if you are new to the federal government

Additional vacancies may be filled through this announcement in this or other GSA organizations within the same commuting area as needed; through other means; or not at all.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits

A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:

Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)
Life insurance coverage with several options
Sick leave and vacation time, including 11 paid holidays per year
Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Long-term care insurance
Training and development

Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.
